steps: Open the official privacy request page and review its branded MyLife JotForm.
Provide your accurate first and last name, full state, city, ZIP and explicitly entered birth year; do not infer a year from age.
The browser companion can prefill only the six separately reviewed fields. Email, street address, optional aliases and profile URL remain blank.
Complete any broker verification, genuine challenge and final submission on the official form. Do not upload identity documents.
Preserve the actual response; a filled form or confirmation is not independently verified deletion.
